name: @kickside/sync-ui
title: KickSide Data Sync Create
description: Data Sync create web component for kickside/sync.

wippy.description: Data Sync web components served from /kickside-sync. kickside-sync-create (the package's primary tag) is the creation wizard the automation manager mounts to build a Source -> Transform -> Destination pipeline and install it as a kickside.sync:sync automation: type-id selects the installable type, parent-id is the workspace folder (omit for root), and submit-nonce is the host's inbound submit command; it emits automation-installed { success, id?, error? } on every attempt, created { id } on success, close on cancel, and submit-state { saving }. kickside-sync-manage is the settings view of an installed data sync, mounted with config { id }: it seeds every stage from the stored install declaration and saves through reconfigure (renaming the automation when the name changes), with the destination and reconcile capability locked; it emits change { id }, close and error { message, error }. The Source stage embeds kickside-trigger-config and the Transform stage embeds kickside-transform-assist, so both tags must be resolvable in the host.

type-id.description: The installable automation type this create wizard installs (set by the automation manager).

parent-id.description: The workspace folder to place the new automation under (omit for root).

submit-nonce.description: Monotonic host command; each new non-empty value submits the embedded form once.
